title: After workflow create: registry refresh + immediately launchable
description:
## Why (QA P1)
After Create workflow, UI claimed Settings → Workflows / $ typeahead would show the def. Live QA: Tools → Workflows empty after create and reload; $ showed no workflows. Create→launch-by-name broken until inventory/registry rescan.

## Product
1. On successful host create/save: force settings inventory refresh + workflow registry rescan
2. Only claim success in chat after host confirms save path / list includes name
3. New workflow appears under Tools → Workflows and in `$` typeahead without restart
4. Optional: offer Launch now that actually works
5. Coordinate with lp-khq.11 / lac-bwe authoringDir + registryScan wiring on agent host

## Where
- ChatView processWorkflowWizardResult / scheduleInventoryRefresh
- Agent workflow create/save + host-api registry rescan
- Settings snapshot workflows list

## Acceptance
- Create → Tools → Workflows shows new row without reload gymnastics
- `$name` or launch by name works after create
- Failed create does not claim success
acceptance_criteria: Created workflow in inventory and launchable; honest success/fail; cross-repo host rescan if needed

title: Workflow wizard: natural-language first (no JSON/IR jargon or stage DSL)
description:
## Why (QA P0/P1)
Users describe workflows in plain English. Current wizard:
- Forces kebab-case name prompts
- Custom stages demand `name: agent prompt` lines or `research | write`
- Multi-sentence NL stages collapse into one truncated kebab stage (lost phases)
- User-visible strings mention IR JSON, host workflow tool, Call workflow({…})

## Product
1. Primary path: invite free-form description of what the workflow should do (can still use light MCQ steps for name/confirm)
2. Parse NL → structured stages/agents **internally** (portal heuristic and/or agent)
3. Never show IR/JSON/tool-call syntax in chat or + menu copy
4. Show a plain-language summary before create for confirm
5. Reject/repair bad parses rather than silently kebab-casing whole paragraphs into one stage

## Where
- workflowChatWizard.ts (prompts, stages_custom parse, copy)
- ChatView.tsx (start message, formatWorkflowCreateAgentRequest visibility — hide raw agent instruction from user transcript or rewrite user-facing text)
- composerAttachMenu.tsx description for New workflow

## Acceptance
- Multi-sentence research→write prose becomes ≥2 stages or a clear clarify step
- No user-visible "IR JSON", "JSON paste", "host workflow tool", or Call workflow({
- Name can be derived from NL if user gives title in prose
- Unit tests + Playwright proof under artifacts/ui/
acceptance_criteria: NL multi-phase text parses correctly; zero IR/JSON jargon in user chrome; tests+screenshots
notes: Implemented NL-first wizard. commit=9f90a663ddc03890456948d2ad625950d4a4414d pr=https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/435 evidence=artifacts/ui/lp-khq.12.1/ (PASS: 2 stages, research-report, no IR/JSON jargon). Unit + Playwright story proof green.
close_reason: Merged platform PR #435 (squash): NL-first workflow wizard (free-form describe, multi-phase ≥2 stages or clarify, plain-language confirm, no IR/JSON/tool jargon). Review approved; UI QA PASS (artifacts/ui/lp-khq.12.1).

title: Bug: model-generated agent title after first message (stop Hound keyword map)
description:
## Why
Every agent is named Hound. User example "Hound" was product intent for creative naming, not a hard-coded map entry. Titles must be **generated by the model** after the user sends their initial request.

## Root cause
`portal/packages/bff/src/agent-name.ts` `OFFLINE_CODENAME_RULES` maps sales/pipeline/outreach → "Hound". Assign-name falls back to `fixtureAgentNameFromMessage` whenever host suggest_title fails — so real product chats become Hound.

## What
1. **Bootstrap (eager create, empty message):** always leave generic title ("New agent") — do **not** run keyword map on empty or pre-message context.
2. **After first user message:** call host `chat.suggest_title` with instruction that the model invents a short name fitting the request; apply as chat title when applied.
3. **Remove or demote** product keyword map (Hound/Scout/…) so it is not the live fallback for normal assign-name. Fixture fallback if host unavailable: generic pool or "Agent", never forced Hound for sales.
4. Mock gateway: if used locally, either call a real model path or return varied non-constant names — do not train users on Hound-only.
5. Tests: sales multi-sentence prompt must not always yield Hound; bootstrap empty → New agent; host path still preferred when ok.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] First-message title assignment prefers model/host suggest_title
- [ ] No keyword rule that hard-codes Hound (or similar) as product offline path
- [ ] Bootstrap remains generic until first message refine
- [ ] Unit tests for policy + assign-name
design: Delete or test-only OFFLINE_CODENAME_RULES; fixtureAgentNameFromMessage uses neutral fallbacks; assign-name after first message is the naming moment; wire ChatThreadContext still fires refine on first send.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Sales/pipeline first messages do not all become Hound via fixture
- [ ] Model/host path documented and used when brain RPC succeeds
- [ ] Empty bootstrap → New agent (or equivalent generic)
- [ ] Tests green
notes: Implemented: removed OFFLINE_CODENAME_RULES; bootstrap always New agent (no host); first-message prefers host suggest_title; neutral hash-pool fixture only. Commit d22113a. Tests 42 green. Not closed (orchestrator).
close_reason: Done. PR https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/389 — removed Hound map; model title after first message.

title: Entrypoint: idempotent ensure-mounted for VAULT_ROOT (Mountpoint)
description:
Implement guest-side ensure-mounted before gateway start (entrypoint or helper script).

Behavior:
1. If VAULT_ROOT already a Mountpoint-S3 (or configured ready mount) and readable → log skip, exit 0 immediately
2. Else if LANYARD_VAULT_BUCKET + S3_VAULT_PREFIX (+ AWS creds/STS) present → mount-s3 to VAULT_ROOT with write flags suitable for pilot (allow-delete/other as required)
3. Else fail closed with clear log (do not start gateway pretending empty local dir is durable vault) OR explicit LANAYARD_ALLOW_EMPTY_LOCAL_VAULT escape for offline only

Must not reinstall packages. Must not run on every BFF request — only guest boot path (create/start → entrypoint).

Depends on snapshot having mount-s3 and CP inject having bucket+creds.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] ensure-mounted is no-op when already mounted (unit/smoke)
- [ ] First boot mounts prefix; ls VAULT_ROOT shows expected objects when S3 seeded
- [ ] Fail closed (or documented escape) when bucket/creds missing — no silent empty vault in prod pilot
- [ ] Entrypoint wait-for-vault remains after ensure-mounted
notes: SHIP: PR #336 ready for review (auto_merge=false). Review approved; no CI checks on branch. Bead already closed. URL: https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/336 commit 19250b63. Leave open for human merge.
close_reason: Idempotent ensure-mounted in agent-gateway entrypoint: no-op if already mounted; mount-s3 once with bucket+prefix+creds; fail closed or LANYARD_ALLOW_EMPTY_LOCAL_VAULT offline escape; wait-for-vault after ensure. Smoke all pass. PR #336 commit 19250b63f9a0e90b6d9e477394dc1d4b45a6c6ba.

title: bug: hard-reload crash/blank after complex multi-subagent chat
description:
## Report
User completed a complex multi-subagent request in Portal. Reloading the thread **crashes out** every time (hard reload / re-open chat).

## Likely area
- GET /api/chat/threads/:id/history hydrate
- historyEventsToTimelineItems / applyChatEvent on large tool_progress + nested subagent/workflow events
- ChatView render of large tool results / nested streams / citations after hydrate
- historyEventsToTimelineItems is not try/catch per-event; a single bad row can fail the whole hydrate or leave unrenderable state

## Repro (user)
1. Run a complex multi-subagent request to completion
2. Hard-reload the browser or re-open that thread
3. Observe crash / blank / unusable chat

## Acceptance
- Reproduce with fixture or captured history payload (add to tests)
- Reload of multi-subagent + many tools does not throw React error boundary / blank screen
- Per-event hydrate isolation: one corrupt tool_progress does not wipe whole thread
- Optional: size/truncate huge tool results on history load

title: projects.create must mkdir vault folder so Directory/Vault sees it
description:
